sourcePolicy: Documentation, reasoning, browser evidence, semantic code navigation, and reviewed local codebase graph read tools can run with approved read-heavy defaults. Authenticated account, database, production, broad filesystem, destructive, mutating, and secret-bearing tools stay disabled or prompt-gated. Each server records sourceUrl, risk, auth, approval, and why it is enabled or disabled.

servers.name: openaiDeveloperDocs
servers.setupHint: No credential or extra input is required.

servers.name: context7
servers.setupHint: Requires npm/npx network access on first startup; no credential is required.
servers.defaultReason: Disabled by default because npx fetches a remote package at runtime; enable only after accepting the pinned package source.

servers.name: sequential-thinking
servers.setupHint: Requires npm/npx network access on first startup; no credential is required.
servers.defaultReason: Configured but disabled in the balanced base to avoid duplicating an overlapping local stdio helper in every concurrent session; the full profile re-enables it.

servers.name: playwright
servers.setupHint: Requires npm/npx network access and local browser control; the managed launcher uses an isolated in-memory profile, blocks service-worker registration, and requires no credential.
servers.defaultReason: Configured but disabled in the balanced base to avoid per-session browser-helper trees; the full profile re-enables its isolated, prompt-gated UI evidence surface.
servers.notes: Browser automation and UI verification with isolated state and service workers blocked by default.

servers.name: chrome-devtools
servers.setupHint: Requires npm/npx network access and starts an isolated Chrome/DevTools bridge; no credential is required.
servers.defaultReason: Configured but disabled in the balanced base to avoid a second per-session browser bridge; the full profile re-enables its isolated, redacted inspection surface.
servers.notes: Chrome inspection with isolated mode and redacted network headers.

servers.name: serena
servers.setupHint: A lightweight managed bridge starts at session setup; it starts the pinned uvx Serena backend only when a read-only semantic tool is actually called.
servers.defaultReason: Semantic navigation remains available without eagerly creating one Serena/LSP tree per Codex client; only read/navigation tools are allowlisted.
servers.notes: Project-keyed lazy Serena pool. Same project reuses one backend; separate worktrees receive isolated backends when used.

servers.name: memory
servers.setupHint: No credential is required; use only for non-secret local memory.
servers.defaultReason: Configured but disabled in the balanced base to avoid an eager per-session local memory process; the full profile re-enables it for non-secret recall.
servers.notes: Local memory graph. Do not store secrets.

servers.name: codebase-memory
servers.setupHint: Requires Node/npx first-run package download; keeps local repository graph state on this machine. Indexing, destructive graph, and admin tools stay prompt-gated or disabled.
servers.defaultReason: Configured but disabled in the balanced base to avoid eager per-session graph runtime cost; the full profile re-enables allowlisted reads while indexing and destructive/admin tools stay disabled or prompt-gated.
servers.notes: Local codebase knowledge graph. Keep generated graph artifacts out of source unless deliberately reviewed. Pinned at 0.8.1 on purpose: 0.11.0 adds an executable-identity check that refuses to start when the user cache directory grants write rights to another local account, and it forces a one-time full reindex.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.setupHint: Choose a deliberate local root path in config args before enabling.
servers.defaultReason: Disabled because broad filesystem access is too powerful for a starter default.
servers.notes: Enable only for intentional local paths.

servers.name: github
servers.setupHint: Requires GitHub/Copilot account authorization; keep disabled until private GitHub context is needed.
servers.defaultReason: Disabled because it requires account authorization; even the readonly endpoint stays prompt-gated after deliberate enablement.
servers.notes: Repository and PR context. Keep disabled until needed.

servers.name: figma
servers.setupHint: Requires Figma account or workspace authorization.
servers.defaultReason: Disabled because it requires private design-account authorization.
servers.notes: Design context. Requires user or workspace auth.

servers.name: linear
servers.defaultReason: Disabled because it can expose private issue/project data.

servers.name: notion
servers.defaultReason: Disabled because it can expose private workspace docs and databases.

servers.name: sentry
servers.setupHint: Requires Sentry organization authorization and may expose production error data.
servers.defaultReason: Disabled because it can expose production error data.

servers.name: vercel
servers.setupHint: Requires Vercel account/team authorization and may expose project or deployment data.
servers.defaultReason: Disabled because it can expose project and deployment data.

servers.name: supabase
servers.setupHint: Before enabling, add a task-specific project_ref query parameter, keep read_only=true, retain only the required feature groups, and complete Supabase OAuth.
servers.defaultReason: Disabled because authenticated database access must be task-specific, project-scoped, read-only by default, and explicit.
servers.notes: Official hosted Supabase MCP over OAuth. Enable only after adding project_ref, retaining read_only=true, minimizing feature groups, and obtaining explicit task approval.
